title: I got a "A" for effort
text: run small, delivery was late. I bought the subscription for my wife as a birthday gift. I snuck around her closest confirming her size, which should have been a PLUS per this product's sizing chart. When it did come, the expected delivery window was missed by about a week. She was still excited. She loved the pattern (which I was well aware of that you cannot pick). She loved the feel of it, how soft it was. However, she was disappointed, as was I, that it did not fit. Unfortunately, there is not larger size. If the delivery was on time and the sizing were accurate this would have been a 5 star item.
label: negative
